summary: Tested the Balans theme's editable page texts using bash, curl and wp-cli only (no browser). 54/54 checks pass: php -l on all theme files; the zip contains page-texts.php and LEESMIJ and matches the source; the Paginakop hero meta changes the NL /over/ h1 while EN and FR keep their own titles; the Over body has a columns block translated in NL/EN/FR with no duplicate hard-coded text, and editing post_content changes the rendered page; contact-content and zakelijk-content ('Twee routes', once) render; balans_migrate_page_texts is idempotent and all 39 template pages are marked migrated; anonymous visitors see no 'aan te leveren' or balans-placeholder-notice on the 15 listed URLs (all 200) or on EN/FR about/contact; the homepage Customizer mods work per language and the panel and sections register; the header shows the inline SVG logo even with custom_logo=1; the CSS values for teal, padding and logo height are correct; main.css has ?ver=2.0.0.<mtime>; no PHP warnings were logged.

minor.issue: Editors cannot leave a hero field empty. If the eyebrow or intro is saved as '', balans_hero() shows the default text again, because '' counts as 'not set'. Verified: blanking _balans_hero_intro on /over/ still showed the default intro.

action_items: Optional: let editors clear the hero eyebrow/intro. For example, fall back to the default only when the meta key does not exist (metadata_exists) rather than when the value is empty, and say so in LEESMIJ.
critical_code_review_comments: balans_hero: the check '' !== $v treats a deliberately empty field the same as an unset one (see the minor issue).
balans_migrate_page_texts runs on admin_init on every admin request. NOT EXISTS keeps the query cheap, but a version option flag would avoid the meta query entirely.
seed_data_creation: None. All test changes (hero title, post_content, theme mods eq5_hp_routes_title_fr and eq5_hp_hero_title_nl, intro meta) were restored or removed. As requested, eq5_hp_hero_title_nl is now removed, so the NL homepage shows the default 'Van vicieuze cirkel naar balans.'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: bash /app/tests/test_page_texts.sh (site at http://localhost:8099, wp-cli with --path=/root/wpf/wordpress --user=admin). Over page ids: nl=8, en=43 (/en/about/), fr=44 (/fr/a-propos/). The theme dir is symlinked into WP.
